name: field-grid
title: Field Grid
description: A responsive one-to-three column grid of Fields by container width, plus FieldChoices: radios or checkboxes in a wrapping row.

meta.whenToUse: Forms with many short fields (specifications, settings) and short choice sets that read better side by side.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single-column dialog form (FieldGroup) or label/value read-only details (PropertyList).
